w:r.w:t: ProctorLess is a privacy‑first smart assessment platform that replaces invasive proctoring with lightweight integrity signals and a simple, reliable quiz engine.
Traditional proctoring tools (Respondus/ProctorU) are intrusive and raise anxiety; simple LMS quizzes don’t log tab‑switch integrity and require manual grading.

ProctorLess adds a tab‑switch monitor (no webcam), a robust quiz editor, a 5‑minute buffer and optional timer, draft autosave/restore, and a results dashboard with per‑question grading and an AI‑assist hook. OCR/Gemini parsing converts exam assets into MCQs/Q&A quickly.

Students retain privacy and clarity; professors save time and get actionable integrity logs. The MVP is scoped for a 1‑week, $0 budget using free tiers (Next.js, Supabase, Vercel; OCR/Gemini with fallbacks), guided by the PRD and Tech Design.
Browser security constraints for destination URLs, resilient timers derived from persisted start time, RLS policies, stable OCR/Gemini integration, and end‑to‑end reliability under free‑tier limits.
